meta.note: All figures computed from the league archives (Yahoo 2011-2022, Sleeper 2023+, the league xlsx). Purse from 2016 (winner-takes-all era); tax from 2017. PAR = rest-of-season points above replacement.

rules.format: 12-team superflex, half-PPR, keeper league on Sleeper (founded 2011 on Yahoo at 8 teams; 10 from 2013, 12 from 2019; moved to Sleeper in 2023)
rules.keepers: Up to 4 keepers; cost = round drafted minus 2 per year kept; max 3 consecutive years kept (the clock follows the player through trades); R1/R2 forfeits are ineligible; missing the exact cost round bumps the keeper to the next earlier owned free round
rules.draft_order: Consolation-bracket placements set picks 1-6 (toilet-bowl winner drafts 1st); playoff finish reversed sets 7-12 (champion drafts 12th). In force since 2015 ('You can tank, but at what cost?')
rules.money: Dues $150 (were $75 in 2015, $100 2016-21). Winner takes the pot; regular-season best gets the buy-in back (voted 2016). Low-score tax: each regular-season week the low scorer pays the top scorer — $10 flat 2017-18 (born 'to prevent tanking'), 10+5 per consecutive low 2019-21 (newcomers flat $10), $15 +$5 per additional low week since 2022
